extDescription.message: The security layer for Chrome. Stops phishing, ads, ClickFix, AI/crypto lookalikes, miners, tracking links, and unsafe downloads — and says so honestly.

popup_localOnly.message: Local protection active. Online reputation unavailable.

popup_lifetime.message: All time: $1 trackers · $2 threats · $3 downloads stopped

popup_resumeHint.message: Blocking is on again for this site.

popup_pauseHint.message: Turns ads and extra blocking off here if a shop or login looks broken. Restarts automatically.

popup_allowHint.message: Spears stand down. Blocking is skipped here until you reverse it.

popup_revokeAllowHint.message: This host is on your allowlist. Blocking is skipped.

status_hint_protected.message: No warning signs on this address. Hostile requests are still cut off in the background.

status_hint_protectedHits.message: Stopped $1 tracker request(s) on this page.

status_hint_allowed.message: This site is on your allowlist. Blocking is skipped here.

status_hint_paused.message: Blocking is off for this site until the pause ends.

status_hint_watching.message: Open a website. Fundament will name anything that is not safe.

status_hint_notEncrypted.message: This site uses HTTP. The network can read or change the page.

popup_errorReload.message: The popup hit an error. Reload the extension on chrome://extensions, then open this again.

popup_integrityFail.message: This install does not match its fingerprint. Reload from a trusted build.

popup_aboutBody.message: Deterministic local scoring. Weights are public and versioned. Unavailable signals stay unavailable — never “safe”.

toggle_trackersHintFree.message: Free blocks core ads and analytics. Pro adds the extended tracker catalog plus fingerprinting, social pixels, and telemetry.

toggle_trackersHintStore.message: Blocks the bundled ad and analytics hosts.

toggle_trackersHintPro.message: Includes the extended catalog and fingerprinting / social / telemetry endpoints.

toggle_httpsHint.message: Loads scripts, images, and other files over HTTPS when the site asked for HTTP.

toggle_httpsPagesHint.message: Tries HTTPS for the whole page. Can break devices that only speak HTTP.

toggle_pageChecksHint.message: Looks for password boxes on HTTP, forms that post off-origin, mixed content, weak CSP, hidden AI instructions, QR lures, and inline-script gadgets. Never reads what you type.

toggle_cosmeticHint.message: Off by default. Hides a small bundled set of ad slots. Allowlisted sites are skipped.

toggle_cosmeticHintFree.message: Pro. Hides a small bundled set of ad slots without remote CSS.

toggle_overlayHint.message: Flags large high z-index layers used for clickjacking or fake permission dialogs.

toggle_downloadsHint.message: Stops obvious malware tricks: programs over HTTP, double file extensions, and a small host list.

toggle_cspHint.message: Appends CSP frame-ancestors 'self' and sets X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN on top-level pages. Off by default — it breaks sites that must be framed.

toggle_fingerprintHint.message: Detection is always on with page checks. This toggle adds tiny canvas noise and can break drawings or games.

toggle_iocHint.message: Applies shipped IOC hosts (malware/C2/miners) in the network layer, including document loads. Optional pinned HTTPS feed; rollback keeps the previous snapshot.

toggle_iocHintStore.message: Applies the bundled malware, C2, and miner hosts in the network layer, including document loads.

toggle_stripHint.message: Removes click IDs such as utm, fbclid, and gclid from page addresses.

toggle_gpcHint.message: Sends Sec-GPC and DNT so sites that honor it stop selling your data.

toggle_hardenHint.message: Stops WebRTC from leaking your local IP, turns off prefetch, and blocks hyperlink pings.

toggle_notifyBlockHint.message: Sites cannot ask to send notifications. Turn off if you need WhatsApp Web or similar. Off by default.

toggle_searchMarksHint.message: On Google, Bing, and DuckDuckGo, flag lookalike or high-risk destinations before you click. Local check only.

toggle_reputationHintPro.message: Optional. Sends only the site origin to your reputation server (Safe Browsing). The API key stays on the server.

toggle_reputationHintFree.message: Pro. Looks up the site origin with Safe Browsing via your server.

popup_historyEmpty.message: Nothing recorded yet. Fundament only keeps a short, local log.

warn_missingTab.message: This warning is missing its tab.

warn_cut.message: Fundament cut this connection before the page could run.

warn_fallback.message: This site may be impersonating a known service.

onboard_1_body.message: Fundament is the lock on every door: known phishing sites, lookalike logins, fake CAPTCHA commands, wallet drainers, trackers, and bad downloads — stopped before they load.

onboard_2_body.message: Green only means we found no warning signs. HTTP, lookalikes, and traps are named. Everything is checked on your device; we never read what you type.

onboard_3_body.message: The toolbar is enough. If a page looks broken, tap Pause. Right-click to allow or block. The dashboard also tells you when Chrome needs an update or an extension suddenly wants more access.

onboard_4_body.message: Click the puzzle piece in Chrome’s toolbar, then the pin next to Fundament. Otherwise the icon hides and you will miss warnings. Incognito: enable Fundament under chrome://extensions if you browse there.

notify_downloadBody.message: A file from $1 looked like a malware trick (double extension, HTTP program, or listed host). It was not saved.

plan_hint.message: Free checks phishing, ClickFix, HTTP, downloads, and bundled ads on this device. Pro adds the extended tracker list, fingerprint shielding, cosmetic hiding, longer history, and bigger lists.

plan_homeUpsell.message: Pro adds the extended tracker list, fingerprint shielding, and cosmetic hiding.

plan_checkoutHow.message: Opens checkout in a tab. After you pay, click Activate in Fundament — or paste the license below.

plan_extra.message: Miners, ClickFix, AI/crypto traps, tracking-link strip, GPC, WebRTC

plan_comingSoon.message: Pro checkout is not in this build. This release is the full free product. Paid extras come later.

plan_checkout.message: Checkout is not connected yet. After you buy, paste the signed license here.

dash_extensionsNote.message: Chrome lists other extensions and the permissions they declared. Fundament does not disable them. High risk means the extension can read a lot of site data or use powerful APIs — not that it is malware.

dash_extensionsEmpty.message: No other extensions, or the management API is unavailable.

dash_hibpNote.message: Optional and only when you click Check. The password is hashed in this page with SHA-1, then only the first five hex characters go to api.pwnedpasswords.com (Have I Been Pwned k-anonymity). The password never goes to Fundament’s worker or to any other server.

dash_hibpUnreachable.message: Have I Been Pwned could not be reached. Nothing was sent except a 5-character hash prefix.

dash_hibpClean.message: This password did not appear in the HIBP range. That is not a guarantee it is strong.

dash_hibpHit.message: This password appears in known leaks $1 times. Change it.

dash_hibpFail.message: The check failed locally before anything was sent.

dash_dohNote.message: Chrome extensions cannot set your DNS resolver. To use DNS-over-HTTPS, open Chrome Settings → Privacy and security → Security → Use secure DNS. Fundament will not pretend it encrypted DNS for you.

dash_limits.message: What this build will not do

dash_limitsNote.message: No User-Agent spoofing. Canvas noise is opt-in and off by default. No EasyList compilation in the service worker. No smart-contract simulation and no rewriting of wallet transactions. ClickFix is caught when a page writes a shell command to the clipboard — not after you paste it into Windows Run. Remote filter packs need an HTTPS URL and a SHA-256 pin. No remote CSS. No automatic password uploads. Certificates stay Chrome’s job. Mixed content is detected, not rewritten.

dash_packNote.message: Optional. Fundament never downloads EasyList and compiles it here. You can point at a JSON pack of hosts that you hashed first. Empty URL keeps only the shipped lists.

dash_packPro.message: Pinned remote packs are Pro. Free keeps the lists shipped in the extension.

dash_integrityOk.message: Files match the fingerprint stored at install.

dash_integrityFail.message: Files do not match the install fingerprint. Reload from a trusted build.

dash_iocNote.message: Remote lists must be HTTPS and pinned. Fundament never sends visited URLs to a feed. Leave the URL empty to reload the shipped list.

dash_loadError.message: Could not load settings. Reload the extension.

warn_noAnalysis.message: Fundament could not reload the details for this warning. Go back and open the link again.

warn_continueConfirm.message: I understand the risk — open it

dash_postureNote.message: An extension is only as safe as the browser below it. These are the Chrome settings that matter most.

notify_downloadBodyReason.message: A file from $1 was not saved: $2.

notify_extBody.message: “$1” updated and can now: $2. If you did not expect this, disable it in chrome://extensions.

posture_versionUnknownBody.message: Open your browser's About page and install any pending update.

posture_versionManualBody.message: Fundament cannot compare this browser with the latest release. Check its About page for updates; browser updates fix actively exploited holes.

posture_versionOkBody.message: Security fixes from the latest stable release are installed.

posture_versionOldBody.message: This Chrome version no longer gets security fixes that everyone else already has. Open About Chrome; if no update appears, Chrome may be blocked from updating.

posture_sbOffBody.message: Google's live list of malware and phishing sites is not protecting you. Fundament is a second layer, not a replacement. Turn on Standard or Enhanced protection.

posture_sbOnBody.message: For the strongest setting choose Enhanced protection in Chrome's security settings.

posture_3pcOnBody.message: Trackers embedded on many sites can follow you with their own cookies. Blocking them breaks very few sites.

posture_versionRollingBody.message: Google started shipping this update recently. Chrome installs it on its own within a few days; relaunch Chrome when it asks.

dash_missedPhishNote.message: Opens a public GitHub issue. Send the domain only, never the full address.

dash_feedShipped.message: $1 known phishing hosts ship with this version and are blocked before they load.

dash_feedLiveOff.message: Daily updates are not set up in this build. The list above is refreshed with every release.

toggle_liveFeedHint.message: Downloads a signed file with phishing sites found since this release. Nothing about you is sent.
